summary: Every change to support access is now recorded, and naming the first SuperAdmin needs no database rights.

new.title: Name a SuperAdmin without database rights
new.text: When an install has no SuperAdmin, you can now name one without database rights. Admins and Readers are still given on the Access page.

fixes.title: Support access changes are now audited
fixes.text: Every change to Invardia's support access, and every refused support session, is now recorded in Audit.
